scheme_name: Scheme For Campus Accommodation & Facilities Enhancing Social Experience
other_conditions: Institute must be AICTE‑approved Government or Government‑aided engineering college, university department, or polytechnic.
Institute must have been in existence for at least five years.
Institute must have at least 200 SC/ST students on roll.
Institute must have at least 60 students from NER per year.
Institute must have at least 150 differently‑abled students on roll.
Annual Progress Report must be submitted within 2 months of year completion.
Project Completion Report must be submitted after project completion.
Utilization Certificate and Statement of Accounts must be submitted in prescribed proforma audited by the Finance Officer/Account Officer.
If construction work is not initiated within six months, the amount must be refunded to AICTE with accrued interest.
Any reduction in the construction plan or facilities is not allowed.
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹3.25 crore for construction of hostels, gyms, indoor sports clubs and libraries, with phased disbursement of funds.
